title: Lena and the Colony
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: August Amberdale, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
